# Paths under /source left out of the off-NAS backup, one restic pattern per line.
# Leaving something out loses it for good if the NAS dies: only list what is dumped elsewhere,
# regenerated by its app, or not worth keeping, and say which.

# Live database folders: a copy of a running database can't be restored.
# scripts/backup_databases.sh dumps them into /source/databases instead.
/source/appdata/immich/postgres
/source/appdata/opusline/postgres
/source/appdata/prowlarr-postgres

# Queue and cache only
/source/appdata/opusline/redis

# This backup's own SSH key and cache: the key opens the Storage Box
/source/appdata/restic

# Regenerated by Immich from the originals
/source/photos/thumbs
/source/photos/encoded-video

# Regenerated by Plex: artwork cache and generated thumbnails
/source/appdata/plex/Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server/Cache
/source/appdata/plex/Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server/Media
